2.05.betting_forecast: 4/6 Harry Knows, 4/1 Rollthedicebaby, 8/1 Armor Supreme, 10/1 Moriarty Moon, 14/1 Super Tuscan, 16/1 Ballisty.
2.05.spotlight_verdict: The betting should prove highly informative in this juvenile novice but Richard Hughes' Mehmas colt HARRY KNOWS shaped well on his debut when a strong-finishing runner-up at Newbury and is taken to go one better with improvement very much on the cards. Richard Hannon's Solider's Call filly Rollthedicebaby appeals most of the newcomers, although Super Tuscan commands plenty of respect for last year's winning stable.[Peter Entwistle]

horses.spotlight_comment: 4,000euros yearling; Armor filly; half-sister to four French winners, notably Daimyo (6.5f-1m; RPR 96) and Bijin (1m; 93); dam, 1m/1m2f winner (81), is a half-sister to 1m 2yo Group 3 winner Fantastic View; the betting can prove an accurate indicator.
35,000euros foal, £32,000 yearling; Lucky Vega colt; dam, French 1m winner (RPR 78), is out of a French Listed-placed 7f winner; stable is going well so he's a much respected newcomer.
3,800gns foal, 25,000gns yearling; dam, placed over 5f (RPR 63), is a half-sister to smart sprint winners Tis Marvellous (5f-6f Group 2) and Mythmaker (6f); this Belardo colt can't be discounted.

17-2, shaped promisingly on his debut when beaten a head in nine-runner maiden at Newbury (5f, good) two weeks ago, finishing well having been hampered at the start; this son of Mehmas has a fair bit more to offer so rates a big player.

35,000gns yearling; Starspangledbanner colt; half-brother to four winners, notably She Do (6f Listed; RPR 104) and Sydney Street (6.5f-1m; 94); dam, US 1m winner, is a half-sister to Listed-placed 7.5f winner; the market can guide.
Post and a half-sister to 8.6f-1m4f winner Dubai Bounty (dam of smart sprinter Kachy); appeals on paper and must enter calculations for her in-form stable.

22,000gns yearling; half-brother to 7f winner Monfrid (RPR 85); dam, Group-placed 7f-8.3f winner (109), is out of useful 5f-7.5f winning half-sister to 1m1f Grade 2/1m2f Group 2 winner Triple Threat; yard took this 12 months ago so this son of Dark Angel is very much one to consider.

2.40.betting_forecast: 13/8 Pacific Avenue, 7/4 Pathein, 11/4 Protection Act, 10/1 Allegresse.
2.40.spotlight_verdict: None of the quartet can be ruled out but Ed Dunlop's twice-raced PATHEIN looked a good prospect for 2026 when fifth in the Autumn Stakes at Newmarket and can resume winning ways on his return. Protection Act wasn't seen out after making an impressive start in a Haydock novice last July but could emerge as the main danger ahead of the useful pair Pacific Avenue and Allegresse.[Peter Entwistle]

horses.spotlight_comment: Looked on the up when making all in a pair of 1m Kempton novices in the autumn but he failed to get home when beating only one in Zetland Stakes at Newmarket (1m2f) on final 2yo run; since gelded and it would come as no surprise to see this son of Oasis Dream bounce back.
horses.breeding: b g Oasis Dream - A Legacy

horses.spotlight_comment: A useful 7f/1m winner at 2yrs and he has acquitted himself well in Qatar and Meydan over the winter, runner-up in 1m Listed event in February; he holds solid form claims.
horses.breeding: gr c Dubawi - Lumiere

horses.spotlight_comment: Son of St Mark's Basilica who created a good impression when making a winning start in 1m Doncaster maiden in September; built on that form when fifth of seven in Newmarket's Autumn Stakes (1m) following month, fading only late on; big shout with better still to come.
horses.breeding: b c St Mark's Basilica - Excellent View

horses.spotlight_comment: 5-1, impressed when going in at the first time of asking in novice at Haydock (7f, good) last July, showing a good turn of foot; off since but this son of Starspangledbanner remains with plenty of potential.

3.15.betting_forecast: 4/1 Lexington Blitz, 6/1 Tropical Storm, 15/2 Clearpoint, 8/1 Democracy Dilemma, Rogue Enforcer, Rosario, Trefor, 10/1 King Of
3.15.spotlight_verdict: This is wide open. Robert Cowell's trio all enter calculations with Lexington Blitz (second choice) rating the pick, while last year's victor Rosario and returning duo King Of Light and Trefor can have a say too. But TROPICAL STORM did well to run on into eighth at Musselburgh on his reappearance given he lost ground when impeded soon after the start and this speedy sort can take advantage of a reduced mark.[Peter Entwistle]

horses.spotlight_comment: Completed a 5f AW hat-trick last backend and has continued in fine form this spring, runner-up in 5f Southwell handicap last time; must enter calculations back on turf.
horses.breeding: b g Ardad - Pigeon Point

horses.spotlight_comment: Useful front-runner who returned with a good third in 5f AW listed event at Lingfield in February; not at his best on soft ground at Musselburgh since but can bounce back here.
horses.breeding: b g Cotai Glory - Majestic Alexander

horses.spotlight_comment: Ended 2025 better than ever (cheekpieces on and tongue tied) with Haydock victory and fourth at Ascot (both 5f); yard is going well so he's very much one to consider on his return.
horses.breeding: ch g Mehmas - On The Stage

horses.spotlight_comment: Gained a deserved success at Catterick (5f) in October and resumed from five months off with a good third of 14 in 5f Musselburgh handicap 27 days ago; a likely player off an unchanged mark.
horses.breeding: b g Invincible Spirit - Broken Time

horses.spotlight_comment: Notched three 5f handicaps in 2025 and he has continued in decent form this season, fifth of 14 at Musselburgh last month; ought to be thereabouts once more off an easing mark.
horses.breeding: b g Pearl Secret - Street Jazz

horses.spotlight_comment: A fairly useful 5f winner at 2yrs for Peter Chapple-Hyam; also scored three times in France/Italy in 2025 (signed off with 5f Listed success in Milan); since gelded and he can't be ruled out now starting out with Archie Watson.
horses.breeding: b g Profitable - Skip To My Lou

horses.spotlight_comment: Captured this prize last year and largely in good form after, despite his customary slow starts; should strip sharper for his reappearance sixth in 5f Newmarket handicap 17 days ago so he's no forlorn hope in refitted cheekpieces.
horses.breeding: ch g Harry Angel - City Glam

horses.spotlight_comment: Enjoyed an excellent 2025 when a four-time scorer, including in 5f Group 3 at Dundalk in October; yet to fire this term and failed to beat a rival in 5f Pontefract handicap last month; tried in a change of headgear here.
horses.breeding: b g Sioux Nation - Thames Pageant

horses.spotlight_comment: A three-time winner (around 6f) last season but he ended the term with a rare poor effort in the Portland at Doncaster in September; has gone well fresh though so no surprise to see him bounce back here.
horses.breeding: b g Invincible Army - Silk Bow

horses.spotlight_comment: Bagged 5f York listed event last May; off seven months/gelded before posting an encouraging eighth of 14 in 5f Musselburgh handicap 27 days ago, nearest finish having lost ground when hampered soon after start; not without interest off a reduced mark.
horses.breeding: b g Eqtidaar - Avon Breeze

3.50.betting_forecast: Evs Crepe Suzette, 7/2 Ryka, 13/2 Kissmehoneyhoney, 10/1 Tattycoram, 14/1 Coedana, Incensed, 20/1 Miss Wong, 25/1 Crystal
3.50.spotlight_verdict: William Haggas' debut Leicester winner Kissmehoneyhoney (second choice) brings the prospect of a fair bit better to come in 2026 but CREPE SUZETTE sets a high standard and John and Thady Gosden's very useful filly is a confident selection to make a successful return. Ryka and Coedana can also kick on this season and can't be totally dismissed.[Peter Entwistle]

horses.spotlight_comment: Proved most progressive last season when a dual 1m4f AW handicap scorer in the autumn; steps up in grade here but she's capable of further improvement.
horses.breeding: b f King Of Change - Acts Out Loud

horses.spotlight_comment: Improved by the run last season and ended with an excellent third of 11 in Doncaster's Group 2 Park Hill Stakes in September; yard took this 12 months ago and she's very much the one to beat.
horses.breeding: b f Saxon Warrior - Sultanina

horses.spotlight_comment: Winless in 2025 for Tom Clover but she largely performed with credit; changed hands for 70,000 guineas subsequently but this C&D scorer faces no easy task on her seasonal/yard debut.
horses.breeding: b m Magna Grecia - Mount Crystal

horses.spotlight_comment: Lightly raced filly who showed fair winning form in bumpers before making a successful Flat debut in 1m3f maiden at Kempton in March; capable of better but this demands considerable improvement.

Crystal Ocean filly who looked a good prospect when making a winning start in 11-runner maiden at Leicester (1m2f, good to soft) in September; takes a big step up in grade but this longer trip promises to suit her well, so she shouldn't be passed over at all lightly for leading yard.

Looked firmly on the up when landing a pair of handicaps (around 1m3f) at Kempton and Yarmouth last autumn but she ended 2025 on a low note when tailed off in the St Simon Stakes at Newbury; this is no easy reappearance.
horses.breeding: b f Study Of Man - Oriental Mystique

horses.spotlight_comment: Enjoyed an excellent 2025 and she signed off with a 1m4f listed success at Toulouse in October; remains quite low mileage, so can do better still this season.
horses.breeding: ch f Night Of Thunder - Tulip Fields

horses.spotlight_comment: Largely progressive sort (1m2f winner) last season but she wasn't seen out after posting just a fair fifth of seven in 1m6f Newmarket handicap in August; this demands a clear personal best after eight months off the track.
horses.breeding: b f Camelot - Illaunmore

4.25.betting_forecast: 9/4 Evening Saigon, 5/1 Diligently, Far Above Dream, Uncle Don, 6/1 Many A Star, 10/1 Spring Bloom, 14/1 Dr Strangelove, Kiss
4.25.spotlight_verdict: A case can be made for a few of these but there was plenty to like about the reappearance win of EVENING SAIGON, so Hamad Al Jehani's lightly raced 4yo can defy a 3lb rise. Dual C&D winner Far Above Dream appeals as the main danger, although Diligently and Uncle Don come here on the back of encouraging returns and can also have a say in this competitive sprint.[Peter Entwistle]

horses.spotlight_comment: Ended 2025 on the up and he returned from seven months off (gelded) with an encouraging fourth of 13 in 6f handicap at Newmarket 16 days ago; well in the mix off the same mark.
horses.breeding: b g Harry Angel - Anna Of Lorraine

horses.spotlight_comment: Gelded and off six months before a never-dangerous fourth of five in 6f Lingfield handicap 11 days ago; this dual 6f winner in 2025 can take a step forward now.
horses.breeding: b g Mohaather - Cheap Thrills

horses.spotlight_comment: Low-mileage 4yo who got back on the up when making a winning return in 6f Newcastle handicap 18 days ago; up 3lb but had a bit in hand there and merits serious consideration.
horses.breeding: b g Harry Angel - Hoodna

horses.spotlight_comment: A three-time winner for James Owen in 2025, signing off with a second C&D success in October; has a career-high mark to overcome on his seasonal return but not taken at all lightly.
horses.breeding: b g Far Above - Silk Slippers

horses.spotlight_comment: Course scorer who largely ran well without winning in 2025; she has a good record fresh too, so needs considering on her seasonal return.
horses.breeding: b m Twilight Son - Desert Kiss

horses.spotlight_comment: Kickstarted 2026 with all-the-way 6f Wolverhampton win in February; up 2lb but this veteran C&D winner can't be discounted after a break.
horses.breeding: ch g Starspangledbanner - Many Hearts

horses.spotlight_comment: A fairly useful 5f juvenile winner for Richard Fahey; changed hands for 17,000 guineas in January 2025 and he has his fitness to prove after 19 months off (also gelded) for his new yard here.
horses.breeding: b g Mehmas - Second Generation

horses.spotlight_comment: On a long losing sequence but he made a good start for his new yard (formerly with Darryll Holland) when second of nine in 6f Leicester handicap 18 days ago; more is needed from 3lb out of the handicap here though.
horses.breeding: ch g Power - Almond Branches

horses.spotlight_comment: A fair 5f scorer for Richard Fahey; made a promising start for Robert Cowell after four months off when second of 12 in 6f Lingfield handicap four weeks ago; up 3lb but he must enter calculations.
horses.breeding: b g Oasis Dream - Bereka

5.00.betting_forecast: 9/4 Lux Aeterna, 3/1 Morbeh, 4/1 Veritable, 5/1 Kokoluna, 8/1 Bridge Of Eagles, 12/1 Foothold, 14/1 Too Hot To Tango.
5.00.spotlight_verdict: A few of these bring potential, not least Ed Dunlop's LUX AETERNA (nap) who scored in eye-catching style at Wolverhampton and can make light of a 6lb rise. Veritable (second choice) and Bridge Of Eagles showed promise as juveniles and could take a sizeable step forward going into handicaps after being gelded, while Nottingham scorer Kokoluna is not out of things either in this intriguing handicap.[Peter Entwistle]

horses.spotlight_comment: Failed to build on earlier promise when sixth of 13 in 1m Kempton maiden last autumn; has since been gelded and he remains with potential now going into handicaps.
horses.breeding: b g Gleneagles - Bridge Of Peace

horses.spotlight_comment: Without a win but got back on track in a first-time hood when fourth of 11 in 1m Bath handicap two weeks ago; he's no forlorn hope on his first go over 1m2f with headgear retained.
horses.breeding: ch g Footstepsinthesand - Claramara

horses.spotlight_comment: Ulysses filly who took a big step forward on her handicap debut when scoring at Nottingham (1m) last month; showed a good attitude there, so she's not taken lightly despite a 5lb weights rise.
horses.breeding: ch f Ulysses - Luna Mission

horses.spotlight_comment: Much improved after three months off (also gelded) when making a winning start in handicaps at Wolverhampton (9.5f) last month, quickening clear impressively off a steady pace; up 6lb but he remains one to be very interested in on his turf debut.
horses.breeding: b g Sergei Prokofiev - Sassy Dresser

horses.spotlight_comment: 0-8 but she's proving a reliable sort and comes here on the back of a good third of nine in 9.5f Wolverhampton handicap in March; handicap debutante.
horses.breeding: b f Too Darn Hot - Last Tango Inparis

horses.spotlight_comment: Improved with each of his three runs as 2yo, cheekpieces retained when runner-up in 1m3f Kempton maiden in December; subsequently gelded and this son of Dubawi can do better still on his handicap debut.
horses.breeding: b g Dubawi - Veracious

5.35.betting_forecast: 11/4 Gallivanted, 4/1 Arcturus Flame, 9/2 Market House, 6/1 Scarlet Moon, 8/1 Diamond Bay, 10/1 Fair Dinkum, 12/1 Cruden,
5.35.spotlight_verdict: This may concern those who have been hurdling this year and GALLIVANTED earns narrow preference over Scarlet Moon and Market House. All three score highly on the consistency front in both disciplines.[Alistair Jones]

horses.spotlight_comment: 8lb higher than for his only handicap win gained nearly a year ago; kept on for a closing fifth at Newbury last time but that was over 1m2f and there are doubts about him over this far.
horses.breeding: b g Too Darn Hot - Kitty Love

horses.spotlight_comment: Won back-to-back at Lingfield last August (2m/1m5f; good) after the cheekpieces went on but the last of those wins was by 12l and she's struggled since, presumably because of her new mark; others appeal more.
horses.breeding: b g Medaglia d'Oro - Moonlit Garden

horses.spotlight_comment: Flat/hurdle winner Jessica Harrington and ran well in defeat over hurdles for James Ewart; beaten 4l (1m6f) and 6l (2m) in two AW races for current outfit, the latest in early January; others safer.
horses.breeding: b g Time Test - Amami

horses.spotlight_comment: Multiple winner who stays well but has failed to beat a rival in his last two races, with and without a visor; now tries blinkers.
horses.breeding: ch g New Bay - Amarillo Starlight

horses.spotlight_comment: Four wins divided between turf and the AW; capable on his day and this trip on this ground is fine, but he's always had two ways of running; well below his best on last two outings.
horses.breeding: b g Australia - Wannabe Posh

horses.spotlight_comment: Progressive juvenile hurdler this winter and returned to the Flat with a close third at Thirsk (1m4f, good); had no excuses but looks sure to win more races in this scene.
horses.breeding: b g Galiway - Fedya

horses.spotlight_comment: 1m6f AW winner for Jamie Osborne but returns to this scene after two heavy defeats over hurdles, the latest after a wind operation; has a bit to prove off this mark even if he's back on song.

Running well on the AW in just a tongue-tie and has continued the good work over hurdles, finishing second (cheekpieces added) before a win 12 days ago (first-time visor); should have a part to play here.
The last of four Flat wins was over this trip at Sandown last summer (good; 5lb lower); has since racked up a solid sequence over hurdles; in form, consistent and respected.
